title: Pocket2D game.config
description: Project startup settings read by GameConfig::Read (src/shared/config/GameConfig.cpp). The file must be a JSON object without duplicate member names. Every field is optional; unknown fields are ignored by the loader and therefore allowed here.

initial_scene.description: Scene name resolved under scenes/ (without the .scene extension) that the runtime and editor open first. Empty means no initial scene.

save_namespace.description: Save-slot namespace for the Lua Save API. Empty disables saving; otherwise 1..64 ASCII letters, digits, '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit (SaveStore::IsValidIdentifier).

splash_screen.description: Show the "Made with Pocket2D" splash before the first frame of the standalone runtime (not in the editor or headless agent runs). Default false.

splash_seconds.description: How long the splash lasts, fades included. Default 2.

show_fps.description: Start the standalone runtime with its frame-rate readout (frames per second and frame time) shown; F3 toggles it while playing. Default false.

max_fps.description: Caps the standalone runtime's frame rate. 0 (the default) draws as often as possible; gameplay ticks 60 times a second either way.

vsync.description: Wait for the display's refresh before showing each frame (no tearing, at most the display's rate). Default false.

package_exclude.description: Extra files `pocket package` leaves out of packaged games: patterns relative to the project, with * wildcards (hidden files, __pycache__, tools/, scenarios/, source_art/ and Markdown are always left out).

package_icon.description: A PNG in the project used as the packaged macOS app's icon (default: the Pocket2D icon).
